actions.action: Entered title and rich-text content without clicking a save control
actions.result: The note list updated to show the new title and content.
The created note remained in All Notes with the exact title and content.

observations.expected: Locally stored notes persist automatically without user interaction
observations.observed: No save action was available or used; after a full reload, 'Autosave QA Note' and its content were still present.

notes: Automatic local persistence was verified by entering content and reloading without an explicit save action.
isolation: Fresh Vite process on case-unique loopback origin http://127.0.0.1:4724; origin-scoped local/session storage cannot carry over from other cases.
